title: 第17章 运筹帷幄1第18章 运筹帷幄2
content_zh:
由于大量难民的进入，柳城的城卫治安开始混乱起来，追梦家的酒楼生意也受到了一定的影响。
追梦得招聘一批打手，来维护治安。
起源6180年7月1日。
早上，阳光明媚。
追梦在左右两排仆人的拥抱下，走出自家酒楼门，大声宣布道：“″邹家酒楼招聘护卫10名，月酬每人2两银钱。
招聘要求，三天后在邹家酒楼门口举办擂台赛，站在台上的最后十人，直接录取。”
追梦宣布完后，就开始安排仆人搭建擂台。
擂台追梦要搭建10个，分别以1号到10号编号。
运筹帷幄，追梦打算分几步，第1步拥有一定的武力。
第2步拥有足够银钱和粮食。
第3步以工代赈，利难民来修建高大的河堤，从而使代芳河两岸产生大量的良田。
第4步新建座主城。
安排好擂台搭建后，追梦带着几名护卫走向李志强家，准备找李志强打听一下柳城难民的事。
近日，因为柳城难民太多，闹出了一些治安问题，李府守卫跟往日不一样，个个都变得严肃警惕起来。
还好追梦经常来李子强家，次数多啦，下面的仆人都知道追梦与自家主子关系好。
守门护卫只是简单的盘问两句，让追梦留下自己的护卫，在门口等待追梦出来，就让追梦一人进入李府。
“老爷，现在柳城那么多难民，妹夫那里有没有说怎么处理的。”
追梦刚到李家客厅门口，就听道柳淼淼在问李志强。
“妹夫也在为这事愁容满面，不知道如何对策。
现在妹夫已经下令，把城门暂时封锁，不让难民进入，先稳住城内的治安正常运行，只允许来往的商队、和办差的官员正常进出。”

李志强愁眉苦脸的说道。
“这样也不是办法，听说城外的难民的有数万之多，人数后面一直还在增加。”
柳淼淼忧心忡忡的说道。
“这也是没办法，今年的旱灾遍布披萨国以西，殃及了大半个披萨国。
在披萨国，只有东边代芳河流域还没有还闹旱灾。”
李志强无力的叹气道。
追梦听到难民的消息，适时想提出自己的对策，打断两人继续交谈，说道：“李叔、李婶，早！
小侄刚刚听到你们在谈及难民的事，不知可否听小侄一言。”
“追梦小子来啦！”
两人这时才注意到，自家来客人了，柳淼淼对追梦点头示意追梦继续说，李志强微笑的对追梦打招呼道。
“哟！
你小子倒是有点子啊！
说来听听。”
李志强随意的开玩笑道。
在李志强心里，难民如何处理的事，连身为城主的妹夫的没有解决方法，他不认为追梦会有什么好的解决方法。
为了不落追梦的面子，才改成开玩笑的方式应付。
“代芳河岸有很多宽阔平整的土地没有被使用，一直空在那里，如果我们想办法把它用上，来年我们柳城粮食产量可是会翻两倍的。”
追梦说道。
“代芳河岸是有很多宽阔平整的土地，那里一直没人使用种植，是因为代芳河河水长期不稳定造成的，每当下雨的时候，代芳河两岸都成了浅水滩，种植的庄稼根本没法活。”
李志强解释道。

柳淼淼也跟着点头，挥手示意站在身后丫鬟上前给追梦倒荼。
“那我们在代芳河两岸修建高大厚实河堤呢？”
content_en:
Due to the influx of a large number of refugees, the security of Liucheng's city guards began to become chaotic, and the restaurant business of Dream Chaser's family was also affected to a certain extent.
Chasing Dreams has to recruit a group of thugs to maintain law and order.
Origin: July 1, 6180.
In the morning, the sun is shining brightly.
Zhui Meng was hugged by the servants in the two rows on the left and right, walked out of the door of his restaurant, and announced loudly: ""The Zou Family Restaurant is recruiting 10 guards, with a monthly salary of 2 taels of silver each.
The recruitment requirement is that a group competition will be held at the entrance of Zou's Restaurant three days later, and the last ten people standing on the stage will be admitted directly. "
After the announcement of Chasing Dreams, they began to arrange for servants to build the arena.
There are 10 arenas to be built for Chasing Dreams, numbered from 1 to 10.
There are several steps to strategizing and chasing dreams. The first step is to have a certain amount of force.
Step 2: Have enough money and food.
The third step is to use work-relief to help refugees build tall river embankments, thus creating a large amount of fertile farmland on both sides of the Daifang River.
Step 4: Create a new main city.
After arranging to set up the arena, Zhui Meng led a few guards to Li Zhiqiang's house, preparing to ask Li Zhiqiang about the refugees in Liucheng.
Recently, because there are too many refugees in Liucheng, there have been some public security problems. The guards at Li Mansion are different from the past, and all of them have become serious and vigilant.
Fortunately, Zhui Meng came to Li Ziqiang's house often, and the servants below knew that Zhui Meng had a good relationship with his master.
The guard guard just asked Zhui Meng a few simple questions and asked Zhui Meng to leave his own guard behind, waiting for Zhui Meng to come out at the door, and then let Zhui Meng enter the Li Mansion alone.
"Master, there are so many refugees in Liucheng now, has your brother-in-law told you how to deal with them? "
As soon as Zhuimeng arrived at the door of Li's living room, he heard Liu Miaomiao asking Li Zhiqiang.
“My brother-in-law is also worried about this matter and doesn’t know how to deal with it.
Now my brother-in-law has ordered that the city gates be temporarily sealed to prevent refugees from entering. He first stabilizes the normal operation of public security in the city and only allows the normal entry and exit of caravans and officials on errands. "
Li Zhiqiang said with a sad face.
"This is not an option. I heard that there are tens of thousands of refugees outside the city, and the number is still increasing. "
Liu Miaomiao said worriedly.
"There is nothing we can do about it. This year's drought has spread all over the west of Pizza Country, affecting most of the country.
In the Pizza Country, only the Daifang River Basin in the east has not yet suffered from drought. "
Li Zhiqiang sighed feebly.
Zhui Meng heard the news about the refugees and wanted to put forward his own countermeasures at the right time. He interrupted the two to continue their conversation and said: "Uncle Li, Aunt Li, morning!
My nephew just heard you talking about refugees. I wonder if I can listen to my nephew. "
“Dreamboy is here! "
Only then did the two of them notice that they had guests. Liu Miaomiao nodded to Zhui Meng and told him to continue. Li Zhiqiang greeted Zhui Meng with a smile.
"Yo!
You guys have some ideas!
Come and listen. "
Li Zhiqiang joked casually.
In Li Zhiqiang's mind, even his brother-in-law, who is the city lord, has no solution to the problem of how to deal with the refugees. He doesn't think Chasing Dreams will have any good solution.
In order not to lose the face of Chai Meng, he changed his approach to joking.
"There is a lot of wide, flat land on the banks of the Daifang River that has not been used and has been left empty. If we find a way to use it, our Liucheng's grain output will triple in the coming year. "
Chai Meng said.
"There are a lot of wide and flat land on the banks of the Daifang River. No one has ever used it for planting. This is because the water of the Daifang River has been unstable for a long time. Whenever it rains, both sides of the Daifang River become shallow shoals, and the crops planted cannot survive at all. "
Li Zhiqiang explained.
Liu Miaomiao also nodded, waving her hand to the maid standing behind her to come forward and help Zhui Meng.
“What about building tall and thick embankments on both sides of the Daifang River? "
